hints.title: Triangular Floor Coverage
hints.text: With m moves and 2 eggs, the first egg can test intervals of size m, m - 1, ..., 1 floors.

hints.title: Sum of First M Integers
hints.text: The maximum number of floors reliably testable in m moves is m * (m + 1) / 2.

hints.title: Solve Quadratic Equation
hints.text: Find the smallest integer m satisfying m * (m + 1) / 2 >= n via mathematical ceiling formula or linear search.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full dynamic programming table takes O(n^2) when closed-form triangular arithmetic is constant time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Closed-form quadratic root evaluation computes the answer in O(1) time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate derives m*(m+1)/2 >= n from the decreasing interval strategy.
